gui.skyabyss.mount.hint: Stats carry over to any look. Click to raise one tier.
gui.skyabyss.mount.title: Stable
item.skyabyss.mount_whistle.desc: A stable whistle. Blow it and your mount comes to you.
item.skyabyss.mount_whistle.use: Right-click to call, again to send it home
message.skyabyss.mount.bought_look: Bought %s and set it as your look
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_abyss: Mounts cannot be called in the abyss.
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_back: Mounts cannot be called on a titan's back.
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_riding: You can't call a mount right now.
mount.skyabyss.look.ash_deer.desc: A tall antlered deer, grey as cinders. Long-legged and made for distance.
mount.skyabyss.look.great_lizard.desc: A low, broad lizard that hugs the ground. Steady under any load.
mount.skyabyss.look.ember_fox.desc: A fire-kit of the ember titan. A coal glows at its tail tip. Light and nimble.
mount.skyabyss.look.horn_beast.desc: A sturdy, broad-backed pack beast with heavy horns. Lent to every traveller from the start.
mount.skyabyss.look.shell_tortoise.desc: Kin of the tide-shell titan. Slow to look at, quick on its feet. You sit on the wide shell.
mount.skyabyss.look.storm_chick.desc: A chick of the thunder-wing titan. Lightning runs through its fluff. Tall, with a fine view.
mount.skyabyss.look.whale_calf.desc: A calf of the stone whale. Mossy slabs on its back, fins that tread the ground.
